name: Grace Hopper (Sample Entry)
bio:
Grace was a pioneering computer scientist and a **Rear Admiral** in the United States Navy. She is credited with popularising the term *debugging* and contributed to the development of [COBOL](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/COBOL).

- Authored the first compiler-related tools in the 1950s.
- Champion of accessible programming languages.
- Advocate for mentoring the next generation of engineers.

> One of her famous sayings: "The most dangerous phrase in the language is, 'we've always done it this way.'"
